author: Kratos1295US
quote:
GOTY for sure. Amazing graphics, Gameplay keeps on improving incredibly, I've thought that REengine had already pushed it's limit but Capcom incredibly keeps on making improvements that's why they are the best company right now. Perfect balance of horror (Grace) and action (Leon). Love the fan service, The care center is a top tier location it had THE MOST variety of Zombies I've seen in a single place, Chef, singers, surgeons, nurses, the blind zombies, chunk etc. And it was also very nostalgic to revisit the ruins of Raccoon city as none other than Leon and his gameplay was epic.

Played this on the PS5 Pro first and then I got it on PC, Thankfully I can run Path Tracing and this game looks AMAZING Capcom is always pushing themselves to new limits That's why they are definitely and by far the best video game company today.
